The focused Replace a device flow: the device count, the devices as radio rows with the device unused longest preselected and tagged "Least recent", so the person sees why, the confirm, and Replace and continue. In browser mode it opens the product's manage page instead. On TV and console the manage page shows as a QR code, which screen readers hear as "QR code that opens the device management page".

## In each kit

<Tabs syncKey="ui-kit">
  <TabItem label="Terminal (Python)">
    <KitStatus kit="terminal-python" />

    **Drop-in.** `activate` when the license is full: browser mode (UI-KITS §4.3): Enter opens `manageUrl`, then Enter tries again.

    **Styled part.** `screens.device_limit(kit, view, opened=…)` in `polaris_key.ui.terminal`, drawn with a `Kit`; restyle through
    `Theme(colors=…, symbols=…, preset="native")`.

    **Headless.** `activation_view(...)` → `ActivateView(component="DeviceLimit")` in `polaris_key.ui.core.models`.

  </TabItem>
  <TabItem label="Terminal (Node)">
    <KitStatus kit="terminal-node" />

    **Drop-in.** `activate` (and `enroll`) when the device limit is reached: the device count and Polaris Locker
    page that makes room (`browser-mode`). Enter opens the page, then Enter tries the key again.
    Without a Locker link (`default`), or with no terminal to ask on, it ends with the command to
    run once there is room, and exit code 1. `devices deauthorize <deviceId>` makes room from a
    device that holds one.

    **Styled part.** `seatMeter(ctx, used, limit)`, `linkSpan` and `hintsRow`.

    **Headless.** `activationOutcome(result).deviceLimit`: `browser-mode` or `default`, with `used`,
    `limit` and `manageUrl`; `seatCells(used, limit)` for the meter.

    [Terminal (Node)](/docs/build/ui/frameworks/terminal-node/) has the adapter's options, the
    `--json` contract and the fallbacks.

  </TabItem>
  <TabItem label="SwiftUI">
    <KitStatus kit="swiftui" />

    **Drop-in.** On the key path, Activate hands off to Replace a device in the browser (`manageUrl`) and retries the key once on return.

    **Styled part.** `DeviceLimitView(screen:devices:selection:onOpenBrowser:onReplace:onBack:)` (the browser mode, and the radio list when the inputs carry devices), `DeviceRow`, `SeatMeter`; `.deviceLimitStyle(_:)`.

    **Headless.** `KitStates.deviceLimit(_:)`.

    [SwiftUI](/docs/build/ui/frameworks/swiftui/) has the theme, the restyle hooks and the sample.

  </TabItem>
  <TabItem label="Electron">
    <KitStatus kit="electron" />

    **Drop-in.** Drawn by `<PolarisKeyGate>` when the license state calls for it, in the chrome of the OS.

    **Styled part.** The React kit's `<DeviceLimit />`, drawn in the macOS, Windows or GNOME chrome with `theme.platform: "auto"`; restyle through `data-part` and the `--pk-*` hooks.

    **Headless.** `viewOf("DeviceLimit", input)`.

    [Electron](/docs/build/ui/frameworks/electron/) has the bridge, the menu and the sample.

  </TabItem>
  <TabItem label="Godot">
    <KitStatus kit="godot" />

    <GodotKitTab component="DeviceLimit" />

  </TabItem>
</Tabs>
